artifacts.summary: Unified skill-orchestrate's Stage MT-4 lock-touching session-id sites to the bare $session_id, added a 5-case register/acquire parity regression group, documented the invariant in the canonical lock spec, and verified gates green with a recorded follow-up for the same pattern in the multi-task command files.

completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed the MT-1/MT-4 session-id mismatch in skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md that caused every multi-task /orchestrate lock acquire to be refused against the batch's own session-registry registration, added a regression test group that reproduces and pins the fix, and documented the parity invariant in the canonical task-lock spec.

memory_candidates.content: task-lock.sh's session-registry contention self-exclusion (D4) is an exact string match on session_id. Any multi-task/batch lock consumer that registers via session-register under a bare batch session_id but then acquires/releases/heartbeats per-task locks under a suffixed variant (e.g. ${session_id}_${task_num}) will have its own union-file_scope registration read as a foreign live session, refusing every lock acquire in the batch. The fix is to reuse the exact same bare session_id string across session-register and every acquire/release/heartbeat call for that batch. This exact pattern also exists (unfixed) in commands/research.md, plan.md, and implement.md's acquire-retry/release calls.

A CLI-driven regression test for task-lock.sh session-registry behavior should call the real session-register/acquire/release/heartbeat subcommands against an isolated temp root (mirroring test-conflict-predicate.sh's existing pattern), never hand-write a session registry JSON fixture -- cmd_session_register computes file_scope as a union internally via get_file_scope, so a hand-built fixture would not exercise (and could mask bugs in) that union computation.

check-extension-docs.sh enforces two easy-to-miss invariants after any source-store edit: (1) deployed .claude/ scripts must byte-match their agent-system/extensions/** source (fix: bash .claude/scripts/deploy-headless.sh), and (2) index-entries.json line_count fields must match actual wc -l for every context file (fix: bash .claude/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh --write). Both are silent until this gate is run -- run it as a matter of course after any context/**.md or scripts/**.sh edit, not just at the end of a task.
